t: Shamino's Castle - The Codex of Ultima Wisdom, a wiki for Ultima and Ultima Online

The castle is located within the Lands of Danger and Despair, later renamed the Serpent Isle.

t: Shamino - UOGuide, the Ultima Online Encyclopedia
s: Shamino, one of the Avatar's most trusted companions, has lived long in Britannia, and Sosaria before it. Before the time of Mondain, he was a ranger who wandered the forests of Sosaria in search of adventure. It was he who found young British when he arrived through a moongate into our world.

t: Shamino - The Codex of Ultima Wisdom, a wiki for Ultima and Ultima Online
s: By the time of Ultima I, Shamino had become ruler of one of the eight castles of ancient Sosaria, and along with the King of the White Dragon jointly ruled the Lands of Danger and Despair. During this time, he granted audience to the Stranger during the hero's quest against Mondain.
